observations.body: Paul contrasts those who compel circumcision with his own refusal to boast except in the cross, then speaks of new creation, peace, marks, grace, and the world crucified in relation to him.
observations.label: Boasting only in the cross: textual observation

observations.body: The passage keeps paul, circumcision, cross visible within its Crucifixion evidence.
observations.label: Boasting only in the cross: action, promise, or consequence

payload.posture: Read Galatians 6:11–18 as its own the cross in letters and later memory crucifixion setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: This later passage uses Crucifixion language inside its own argument without retelling the complete Gospel event.
